verdict: Leads are up and cost per lead fell sharply — but pipeline needs attention.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 47 leads at an average cost of $36.51 per lead, with the most recent week showing a 30.77% rise in leads and a 45.11% drop in cost per lead compared to the week prior — a genuine efficiency gain. However, those leads are not yet forming a visible pipeline: 39 contacts recorded in your CRM over this period produced zero tracked opportunities, which points to an intake process gap rather than an ads problem. A five-day pause in ad spend earlier this month also cost an estimated 17 leads at the current rate, and recovery is now underway. Resolving the contact and intake workflow is the priority focus heading into next period, alongside completing the overdue CRM and automation items so leads can be followed up faster and tracked fully.

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not converting into tracked opportunities in the CRM — indicating an intake gap that is losing ground already paid for.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and CRM voice access are being finalized now, with full contact and case-tracking automation targeted for completion by end of September.
